Capabilities.ModelBoundary: One typed property writer, explicit autonomous/feedback clocks, overlap/cancel/visibility/generation ownership. Current Workshop subset: A-owned evaluation and B admission bound to session/world/target/occurrence; broader target and lifecycle qualification remains open.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Reset and old feedback cannot revive retired targets; reduced-motion and offscreen re-entry preserve authority.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Transfer ownership/geometry of solid/liquid/gas without duplication and update collision, ports, mass and inertia; partial transitions remain represented.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Material inventory before/after phase topology is identical; no duplicated handles, mass or collision.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Evaluate material strength from thermodynamic state, then use generic stress/fracture/joint models; a warm but unloaded body need not break.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Declared strength curve changes failure threshold, while unloaded warm body remains intact.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Relate enthalpy and temperature through material heat capacity outside phase transitions; energy and temperature are not interchangeable counters.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Outside phase change, heat equals mass times integrated heat capacity over temperature.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Joint-bound elastic potential and compliant contact store finite work; no target-relative launch impulse.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Independent potential difference equals force work; doubled mass cannot double the available charge.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Shared constrained impulse/effort allocation accounts for finite available work and force/stroke limits.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Independent constrained mass response and supply debit; locked actuator cannot spend useful work on forbidden motion.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Typed magnetic/electric field and material response with bounded source work and particle response.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Material substitution, field reversal, zero field and finite source work against independently calculated paths.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Bounded conserved discrete grains with real openings, collision and size distributions; jam is physical.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Count/mass conservation; mixed-size aperture separation, empty source and blocked outlet controls.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Typed finite-state sensing and intent, deterministic tick/event order and finite actuator supply; no scripts.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Complete finite transition table, absent condition and exhausted source; no direct pose mutation.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Quantity, rate-window, ordered occurrence and protected end-state predicates observe committed authority.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Independent event timeline rejects reversed, duplicate, transient and premature outcomes.
